description:
Start a video in Siren Studio from a description. Siren composes the
first take (about 10 to 20 seconds) and replies with what it made;
nothing is rendered or charged until studio_export. Returns the thread
and Siren's reply. The human sees the same thread in Studio and can
keep editing it there, or you can with studio_edit.

attachments.description: Optional files Siren reads and uses: URLs from upload_media (app screenshots, a logo, a reference picture, a short screen recording). Up to 6.

prompt.description: What to make, in plain words: "an App Store preview for our timer app, calm, show the station picker first". An App Store link works too.

template.description: Optional film id to start from (list_films names them). Omit and the director picks.

name: studio_start
